blocks.title: Let's Sing!
blocks.body: Are you ready to sing Ring-a-Ring o' Roses? It is one of the most fun songs!

blocks.title: Ring-a-Ring o' Roses
blocks.content:
Ring-a-ring o' roses,
A pocket full of posies.

blocks.title: For Parents & Teachers
blocks.content: Encourage the child to do the hand actions while singing this rhyme to build motor skills.
